description: Update the connected Shopify store's browse-abandonment, cart-abandonment, and/or price-drop automation settings. Partial update: omitted sections are untouched, omitted fields within a section keep their current value, and passing null for a section resets it to the platform defaults (browse abandonment: on, 2h delay, 24h cooldown; cart abandonment: on, 1h inactivity, 24h cooldown; price drop: on, 5% minimum drop, 30-day viewer lookback, 7-day cooldown).

browseAbandonment.description: Browse abandonment settings, or null to reset to defaults.

cooldownHours.description: Minimum hours between browse-abandoned events per subscriber (default 24).

delayHours.description: Hours to wait after a product view before checking for abandonment (default 2).

cartAbandonment.description: Cart abandonment settings, or null to reset to defaults.

cooldownHours.description: Minimum hours between cart-abandoned events per subscriber (default 24).

delayHours.description: Hours of cart inactivity before the cart counts as abandoned (default 1).

expireAfterHours.description: Hours after which an untouched tracked cart is dropped instead of being emailed about or merged into by a later add (default 72). A store can empty a cart without sending a removal - a session or reservation timing out, an inventory hold releasing, checkout finishing on another device - and past this window the cart is no longer treated as evidence the shopper still has those items. Set it below delayHours for stores whose carts expire faster than the abandonment delay; those carts are then intentionally never emailed about.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

priceDrop.description: Price drop settings, or null to reset to defaults.

cooldownDays.description: Minimum days between price-drop events per subscriber and product (default 7).

lookbackDays.description: How many days back product viewers qualify as the audience (default 30).

minPercent.description: Minimum price decrease percent to alert on (default 5).

name: update_shopify_automation_settings

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

priceDrop.description: Effective price-drop settings after the update.
